what: The repository's own install path laid the UI built by `npm run build` into a scratch factory root, and the real API, loaded from that root's own .veldo modules with no `ui` in its configuration, served it to Chrome for the sign-in browser checks. Not the live service.
steps: cd engine/ui && npm ci && npm run build
python3 .veldo/init_scaffold.py <scratch root>  (prints: factory UI laid at <scratch root>/.veldo/ui (63 files))
VELDO_ORGANS=<scratch root>/.veldo VELDO_UI_INSTALLED=1 npx playwright test e2e/signin.spec.ts

tests.title: enroll-then-sign-in: a fresh passkey signs in only after the host approves it
unauthenticated access: no screen shows factory data before a passkey session
a session that ends while a screen is open shows the named refusal and drops the data
a member outside a project sees its named refusal and none of its data
route trace: every request each screen makes is a published API route or a built asset

not_covered: The tailnet leg: the phone enrollment and sign-in on the host's Tailscale Serve name with the owner (OPEN.md item 4), and veldo factory setup naming this directory for the installed API service (OPEN.md item 3).
